title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Profile
Biostatistician with 5+ years in pharmaceutical clinical development, clinical assay statistics, and translational research. Experienced in longitudinal and repeated-measures models, time-to-event methods, Bayesian methods, and high-dimensional biomarker data. Strong R and SAS programmer; CDISC SDTM/ADaM expertise; R Shiny developer. Open-source enthusiast and developer of R packages for regulated analytical workflows.

title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Experience
Open-Source Development · ReproStats · Belgium Mar 2025 – Present

Designed and built four R packages covering tamper-evident audit logging, row-level data provenance, CDISC-compliant exclusion tracking, and Bayesian prior elicitation.
Two packages published on CRAN (reproducr, bayprior); two in submission/active development (regulog, lineager).
Built IQ/OQ/PQ qualification suites for regulog covering 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10, §11.100, §11.200 and EU Annex 11 Clauses 9 and 11.


Statistician – FSP · Enovalife · GSK · Brussels, Belgium May 2022 – Mar 2025
Vx Clinical Assay Statistics · Jul 2023 – Mar 2025

Led statistical design, analysis, and interpretation of clinical assay experiments supporting vaccine immunogenicity programmes.
Provided statistical expertise across assay development, validation, and lifecycle management including performance characterisation for pharmacodynamic and predictive endpoints.
Developed and executed statistical analysis plans.
Championed R adoption; designed and deployed R Shiny dashboards and analysis tools to enhance reproducibility, traceability, and reporting.

Vx Preclinical & Research Statistics · May 2022 – Jul 2023

Performed analysis of preclinical data supporting translational research questions.
Designed and implemented statistical analysis plans; conducted QC and compiled analysis reports.
Participated in cross-functional planning meetings on statistical methodology and experimental design.


Statistician – Health Data Scientist · INSERM · Bordeaux, France Jan 2020 – Mar 2021

Wrote and maintained statistical analysis plans for high-dimensional survival data studies incorporating biomarker endpoints.
Implemented advanced methods: time-to-event models, penalised regression, and machine learning-based prediction models.
Co-authored research communications.


Epidemiologist · Cameroon Society of Epidemiology (CaSE) · Yaoundé, Cameroon Sep 2015 – Aug 2016

Designed data collection tools; supervised vaccine programme epidemiological investigations and public health surveillance.

title: Projects
text:
Open-Source Work
    Projects
    
      R packages, Shiny applications, and data science pipelines — built for
      biostatisticians and clinical researchers working in regulated, reproducible,
      and evidence-driven environments.
    
  

  
  
    
      ReproStats Packages
      
        Open-source R infrastructure for regulated and reproducible clinical workflows.
        Published under github.com/repro-stats.
      
    

    

      
      
        
          regulog
          CRAN pending
        
        Tamper-evident, hash-chained audit logging for R
        
          SHA-256 hash chain — any modification detectable by verify_log()
          Electronic signatures per 21 CFR Part 11 §11.100/§11.200
          Auto-log all data I/O with with_log() — no code changes needed
          Shiny integration with per-session audit trails
          IQ/OQ/PQ qualification suite + Requirements Traceability Matrix
        
        
          21 CFR Part 11
          EU Annex 11
          Audit Trail
          Shiny
        
        
          Package site →
          GitHub
        
      

      
      
        
          lineager
          In development
        
        Row-level data provenance and exclusion tracking
        
          Tags every row with a unique lineage ID (.__lid__) that survives filters and joins
          Mandatory documented reasons for every row exclusion
          lg_trace() — trace any subject across the complete pipeline
          CONSORT-style disposition tables with lg_disposition()
          CDISC Reviewer's Guide-aligned HTML provenance reports
        
        
          CDISC ADaM
          Data Provenance
          Exclusion Tracking
        
        
          Package site →
          GitHub
        
      

      
      
        
          reproducr
          CRAN
        
        Behavioural reproducibility auditing for R analyses
        
          Detects silent breaking changes across package updates
          Flags stochastic code, missing seeds, and locale-sensitive operations
          certify() / check_drift() — hash and monitor analytical outputs
          Pharma QC, academic, and minimal report formats via Quarto
          Works with or without renv; zero configuration
        
        
          Reproducibility
          Audit
          CI/CD
          Pharma QC
        
        
          Package site →
          GitHub
        
      

      
      
        
          bayprior
          CRAN
        
        Bayesian prior elicitation for clinical trials
        
          SHELF roulette, quantile & moment matching across 7 distribution families
          Linear & logarithmic expert pooling with Bhattacharyya diagnostics
          Conflict diagnostics: Box p-value, surprise index, KL divergence
          Robust and power priors (Schmidli, Ibrahim–Chen)
          FDA/EMA-aligned regulatory reports via Quarto
        
        
          Bayesian Methods
          Clinical Trials
          FDA/EMA
          Shiny
        
        
          Live App →
          Docs
          GitHub
        
      

    
  

  
  
    
      Reproducibility Pipelines
      
        End-to-end reproducr pipelines across four domains.
        Each is independently runnable with CI that audits, certifies, detects drift,
        and updates the badge on every push.
      
    

    

      
        Clinical Trials · Oncology · renv · Pharma QC
        reproducr-clinical
        Phase III oncology survival analysis with a pharma QC report and sign-off fields. Demonstrates regulated-environment readiness.
        
          GitHub →
          DEMO.md →
        
      

      
        Real-World Evidence · renv · Academic
        reproducr-rwe
        RWE analysis generating an academic-style methods paragraph for journal submission. For epidemiologists and HEOR analysts.
        
          GitHub →
          DEMO.md →
        
      

      
        CMC Statistics · renv · Pharma QC
        reproducr-cmc
        CMC statistics pipeline with pharma QC output for CMC statisticians and regulatory affairs teams in regulated manufacturing.
        
          GitHub →
          DEMO.md →
        
      

      
        Ecology · No renv · Minimal · Live badge
        reproducr-ecology
        Minimal pipeline on Palmer Penguins data — no renv, minimal setup, live CI badge. Accessible entry point for general R users.
        
          GitHub →
          DEMO.md →
        
      

    
  

  
  
    
      Shiny Applications
    

    

      
        Bayesian · Clinical Trials · Stan/MCMC
        ClinicalBayes
        Bayesian dynamic borrowing of historical control data. Supports rMAP, Power Priors, and Commensurate Priors for binary and continuous endpoints with Monte Carlo OC simulation.
        
          ▶ Live App
          GitHub →
        
      

      
        Sample Size · Power · Monte Carlo
        PSClinical
        Sample size and power for clinical trials. Continuous, binary, and survival endpoints; parallel, paired, one-sample designs; Weibull/Exponential survival models.
        
          ▶ Live App
          GitHub →
        
      

      
        Explainable AI · SHAP · DALEX
        ClinicalXAI
        XAI toolkit for ML model interpretation using SHAP values. Global feature importance, local force plots, and stability checks for regression, classification, and survival models.
        
          ▶ Live App
          GitHub →
        
      

    
  

  
  
    
      Data Science & Regulatory
    

    

      
        Quarto Website · R · GitHub Pages · Biomarkers
        Biomarker Data Science Platform
        
          End-to-end biomarker analysis pipelines across four therapeutic areas —
          Immunology, Oncology, Cardiovascular, and Neurology. Multi-omics QC,
          longitudinal mixed models, Kaplan–Meier, Cox regression, PCA/UMAP,
          elastic-net, and random forest. All data simulated with fixed seeds.
        
        
          BiomarkersSurvival Analysis
          Mixed ModelsMachine Learning
          limmaglmnet
        
        
          ▶ Live Site
          GitHub →
        
      

      
        Quarto Report · R · pharmaverse · CDISC
        CDISC-meets-R — SDTM to ADaM Pipeline
        
          Full end-to-end CDISC-compliant pipeline using the pharmaverse
          admiral package. Produces ADSL, ADAE, and ADVS datasets
          with six TLFs — demographic tables, TEAE summaries, vital signs,
          and Kaplan–Meier time-to-event figures — compliant with CDISC ADaM IG,
          SDTM IG, and FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide.
